tool_calls.purpose: Resolve the final spec-review finding by aligning Phase 4B target surfaces with existing Foundation requirements for independent playability QA and explicit .gd.uid repository hygiene.
evidence: The Foundation already requires QA to cover playability and says .gd.uid hygiene decisions must be explicit.
The phase brief now permits game/tests/** only for bounded non-shipping QA fixtures explicitly named by a later Phase 4B Work Package.
A matching test .gd.uid is allowed only when the same Work Package names both files as targets and verification artifacts.
The new permission explicitly excludes broad test frameworks, gameplay implementation, external testing, and .godot evidence.

commands.notes: The bounded test and UID target-surface rules are present.

commands.command: Protected foundation/implementation diff guard with the pre-existing CONTEXT.md diff excluded
commands.notes: No Foundation, game, script, asset, review, schema, profile, or lifecycle change occurred; the user-owned CONTEXT.md diff remains untouched.

notes: WP-046 resolves the final review finding with a narrow phase-brief correction. It does not change Foundation decisions or implementation. Bounded QA fixtures and explicitly named UID sidecars are now authorized target surfaces; gameplay, broad testing infrastructure, external testing, and production scope remain forbidden.
